Immediate
SSVC calls for immediate action with all necessary resources. Typical window: 3 days.
Out-of-Cycle
Act at the next available opportunity outside normal maintenance. Typical window: 14 days.
Scheduled
Handle during regularly scheduled maintenance. Typical window: 30 days.
Defer
Do not act at present; monitor the evidence and reassess changes. Typical window: 90 days.

Why Immediate?

The SSVC Deployer path E:Active / EXP:Open / A:Yes / HI:High results in Immediate.

The official SSVC Deployer path is the deployment decision. KEV, EPSS, CVSS, reachability, and runtime evidence support its inputs; they do not bypass the tree.
